query: 投票权差异 投票权差异 衡量企业表决权配置与经济所有权的一致性程度。重点考察差异化投票权架构（如双重股权）的复杂程度、是否存在对中小股东的实质性不公平以及抵消性保护机制。 一、架构公平性评分 (权重 70%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越/高分）：严格执行一股一票制；公司章程明确所有股份具有同等法律地位；无任何差异化投票安排。 • 1分（合格/中分）：存在适度的差异化架构（如 1:10 及以内的投票权倍数）；通常用于保护初创团队的控制权，且该架构已在主流证券交易所合规备案。 • 0分（不合格/低分）：存在极高杠杆的投票差异（如超过 1:20 的表决权比例）或金字塔持股结构；控制权与所有权严重背离；存在“黄金股”等赋予特定人无限否决权的安排。 二、抵消性保护机制 (权重 30%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（完善）：具备强制性的“日落条款”（如创始人离职或特定年限后自动失效）；在涉及并购、章程修改等重大事项时强制执行一股一票；由普通股东独立选派特定比例的独董。 • 1分（基础）：具备基础的保护机制（如相关关联交易需经无利害关系股东批准），但缺乏自动退出（日落）机制或重大事项的穿透表决权。 • 0分（缺失）：没有任何抵消性安排，控股股东或创始人拥有不受限的永久特权。 一股一票 同股同权 股份法律地位平等 投票权差异 差异化表决权 投票权倍数 日落条款 重大事项一股一票 控制权与所有权偏离 同股不同权保护机制 WVR one share one vote equal voting rights equal legal status of shares voting rights disparity dual-class structure voting multiple sunset clause one-share-one-vote on reserved matters ownership-control divergence weighted voting rights WVR minority shareholder protection 企业是否严格执行一股一票，章程是否明确所有股份具有同等法律地位？ 若存在差异化投票权，其股份类别、投票倍数和控制安排是什么？ 是否有日落条款或失效条件？ 重大事项是否强制恢复一股一票？ 普通股东或中小股东有哪些抵消性保护？ 是否存在黄金股或过高杠杆表决安排？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '投票权差异'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否严格执行一股一票，章程是否明确所有股份具有同等法律地位？ 若存在差异化投票权，其股份类别、投票倍数和控制安排是什么？ 是否有日落条款或失效条件？ 重大事项是否强制恢复一股一票？ 普通股东或中小股东有哪些抵消性保护？ 是否存在黄金股或过高杠杆表决安排？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅声明重视股东权益而无股份类别或表决权依据；仅有独董人数、分红政策或未说明投票权的股权激励；未经章程、股本结构或上市文件支持的一股一票口号。区分：本指标接受严格一股一票作为2分证据，也评估差异架构的投票倍数、日落条款和保护机制；第43项侧重是否同股同权，本项侧重差异程度与抵消保护。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Each of us has a responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations of the countries in which we operate. Our internal guidelines and procedures on human rights, labour standards, environment and anti-corruption are aligned to the seven Fundamental Conventions of the International Labour Organisation. Where there is a difference between the legal requirement and Home Control's own General Business Practices, we subject ourselves to the stricter standard. We believe in competing fairly in a free market for our customers to have the widest possible choice of products and services at competitive prices, and as such are careful to avoid contact with our competitors, or use information obtained about them in ways that would violate the antitrust law. In addition, we have procedures in place to ensure that all our business transactions comply with the relevant export controls and sanction regulations.

[Section]
Good Corporate Governance

[Content]
Each of us has a responsibility to comply with the laws and regulations of the countries in which we operate. Our internal guidelines and procedures on human rights, labour standards, environment and anti-corruption are aligned to the seven Fundamental Conventions of the International Labour Organisation. Where there is a difference between the legal requirement and Home Control's own General Business Practices, we subject ourselves to the stricter standard. We believe in competing fairly in a free market for our customers to have the widest possible choice of products and services at competitive prices, and as such are careful to avoid contact with our competitors, or use information obtained about them in ways that would violate the antitrust law. In addition, we have procedures in place to ensure that all our business transactions comply with the relevant export controls and sanction regulations.

results.text: Our operations in Singapore are governed by the Employment Act of 1968, and our operations in China (which include our China office and our main manufacturing partner in China) are governed by the Law of the People's Republic of China on Employment Contract. Under Article 15 of the Labour Law in China, it is illegal to hire employees under the age of 16. Under the Law of the Protection of Juveniles in Singapore, there are several work arrangement restrictions for employees aged 16 to 18 years old.
